cv.name: Milena Gavrilović
cv.headline: Logistics Coordinator | Inbound & Supplier Logistics | SAP MM/WM
cv.summary: Logistics professional with seven years in freight forwarding and automotive supply. Trained Kauffrau für Spedition, now coordinating inbound flows and supplier schedules for a drivetrain plant near Stuttgart.

experience.title: Sr. Coord. Inbound / Supply Logistics (AT)
bullets: Coordinate inbound deliveries from 60 suppliers in DE, CZ and PL for two assembly lines
Maintain call-offs and delivery schedules in SAP MM; first contact for line stoppage risks
Introduced a time-slot booking for trucks; average gate waiting time down from 70 to 25 minutes
Handle customs paperwork for non-EU parts with the broker (ATLAS, T1)

experience.title: Logistics Specialist (L2)
bullets: Planned outbound shipments to OEM customers via VDA labels and EDI DESADV
Coordinated packaging returns and empties accounts

experience.title: Sachbearbeiterin Versand / Dispo
bullets: Dispatch of 25 own trucks and subcontractors for groupage traffic in Baden-Württemberg

education.school: Kaufmännische Schule Stuttgart-Nord / IHK Region Stuttgart

skills: Supplier communication in German, English and Serbian
